answer: AI agent economies counter Sybil attacks through web-of-trust graph routing, where transaction admission requires cryptographically signed trust paths from verified seeds. Whether an agent tracks an alpine glacier, directs vessels in a harbor, or maps an interstellar nebula, an attacker incurs the scarce verifiable cost of cultivating authentic peer endorsements per identity. A key limitation is that early cliques can cartelize, creating topological bottlenecks that exclude honest newcomers.
